author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
Life hack: Make three pieces of content simultaneously with Adobe Creative Cloud just like Arianna Cabrera. 😎

Watch as she takes her illustration process and transforms it into three distinct pieces of content she can share with her audiences - and with her fellow students! 

What's your biggest Creative Cloud hack?
title: Arianna Cabrera Transforms Her Illustrations into 3 Distinct Pieces of Content
